SELECT COALESCE(
( SELECT price FROM theme WHERE id = #{targetId} AND #{paymentType} = 'THEME' ),
( SELECT cc.numeric_value FROM subscription s
INNER JOIN common_code cc ON s.price_id = cc.id WHERE s.target_id = #{targetId}
AND #{paymentType} = 'SUBSCRIPTION'
AND cc.type = 5
AND cc.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY cc.sort DESC LIMIT 1 ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_purchase ( member_id, theme_id, payment_id, is_used ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{themeId}, #{paymentId}, FALSE )

INSERT INTO subscription ( member_id, target_id, price_id, status_id, payment_id, started_at, ended_at ) SELECT #{memberId}, #{targetId}, common_code.id, #{statusId}, #{paymentId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
FROM common_code WHERE common_code.type = 5 AND common_code.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY common_code.sort DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.member_id AS memberId, p.target_id AS targetId, p.paid_at AS paidAt,
s.ended_at AS endedAt,
cc.name AS payMethod
FROM payment p
LEFT JOIN subscription s ON p.payment_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION' AND p.member_id = s.member_id AND p.target_id = s.target_id
LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON p.pay_method_id = cc.id
ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC
